verdict.rationale: Mastercard publishes a public GitHub repository, Mastercard/open-banking-us-openapi, whose test project generates an API client library from the API specification. That points to a downloadable machine-readable OpenAPI spec for Open Finance US. The MCP toolkit docs also mention generating code from current API specifications. Missing for 10: a first-party docs page explicitly linking a spec download, details on spec format/version and coverage of all endpoints, and independent hands-on confirmation of using the spec.
